scope: Deployed queue function adapter, separate from the runpod-python inventory
verified_contracts: Initialization precedes core configuration, intake and heartbeat; once per constructed worker
Keyword job input, missing/falsey input and __empty removal preserving keyword order
Sync, async and streaming native bodies
Incremental delivery, aggregate results and terminal failure after partial output
Environment concurrency applied to actual worker batch intake and concurrent execution
Local startup, typed init failure and cancellation before worker construction
native_adaptations: Explicit compiled FunctionHandle replaces runtime imports and reflection
Truthy input requires a JSON object rather than Python dict coercion of pairs
usize concurrency parsing; unsupported exotic/overflow inputs use one
Synchronous work uses the blocking pool; already-running blocking calls finish after cancellation
Native streaming init hooks are collected, following existing NativeFunction semantics
Typed native errors, serde_json values and closure-owned state
pending_contracts: Live startup orchestration (native deployed startup is tracked in runtime-bootstrap-startup.json)
Native task launch and live Runpod/container validation (queue/API wiring tracked in native-deploy.json)
